author: petr1petr
body:
once you are strong and game feels too easy, you can go anguish - it will be harder - but for some reason, you will be able to drop "anguished gears" - if you use it for anguished content, it will have higher stats (making the harder content easier)

so it will be harder, after that bit easier, you go to next ang lvl, rinse and repeat
